 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. FC Bayern will hope to consolidate their lead at the top of Bundesliga when they welcome Köln on Friday night. The return of Vincent Kompany to the managerial dugout is the headline story of the game that will start matchday 10 action in Bundesliga.
 The Billy Goats are winless so far away from home as they only earned two points from their last four league outings. Harry Kane scored a hat-trick when the two teams last met in the final matchday of last season.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Here are the lineups for the third Friday night game of the season at Allianz Arena.
 Confirmed FC Bayern vs. Köln Lineups
 Bayern: Urbig; Laimer, Upamecano, Tah, Stanisic; Kimmich ©, Pavlovic; Karl, Olise, Brown; Kane
 Köln: Schwäbe ©; Sebulonsen, Lochoshvili, Schmied, Simpson-Pusey, Sosa; Okon-Engstler, Krauß; Maina; Moore, S. El Mala
